I am **Aditya Zalavadiya (AZ)**, a software programmer and video editor. I am passionate about my work, and because I love what I do, I have a steady source of motivation that drives me to build innovative digital platforms and cinematic experiences.


My ultimate goal is to become a billionaire by age 24, which currently inspires my daily leadership as the Co-Founder & COO @ Qzixon. Outside of technology and business, my favorite hobbies include playing football, formula racing, and theoretical physics.
